paragraphs: I'm a Senior Frontend Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable web applications and SaaS platforms with React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript. I'm currently building a multi-tenant e-commerce marketplace at PaySky, focusing on monorepo architecture, tenant-specific theming, and permission systems.

Previously, I led a frontend team at Geek Labs and delivered real-time and social media integration projects. I'm strong in clean architecture, performance optimization, testing, and mentoring, and I hold a Bachelor's in Computers and Information from Mansoura University.

projects.title: Darts Booking Engine SaaS
highlights: Built a server-rendered, SEO-friendly white-label travel platform with domain-based theme auto-detection and full branding control.
Delivered smooth booking flows for flights, hotels, tours, and custom packages with reusable UIs for B2C, B2B, and B2E channels.
Contributed to a responsive admin dashboard for managing content, services, and themes.

projects.title: Sbaik
projects.subtitle: Gold & silver trading platform
projects.description: Live precious-metals trading and investment platform used by 50,000+ users.
highlights: Built the responsive, user-facing interface with vanilla JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 on an MVC architecture.
Worked closely with the PHP backend team to integrate APIs and deliver smooth trading and investing flows.
Supported the platform's educational side, helping users learn how to save and diversify with gold and silver.

projects.title: Qowa.ai
projects.subtitle: Penetration testing platform
projects.description: Developed a responsive marketing website and client management system for a cybersecurity company specializing in penetration testing. Built client-facing workflows for organization and project management, security assessment coordination, vulnerability findings, exploit evidence, and remediation reporting. Supported integrations with GitHub, GitLab, and CI/CD-related workflows to streamline security assessment processes.

projects.title: MachineGenius
projects.subtitle: AI-powered SaaS platform
projects.description: Developed a modular, AI-powered SaaS platform streamlining content production, video creation, and recruitment through scalable web applications and intelligent integrations.
highlights: AI Content Generation: Accelerated script writing, enabling content writers to produce 5–6+ scripts daily.
Video Production: Built workflows to convert approved scripts into videos using customizable layouts, footage integration, AI-powered generation, and YouTube publishing.
HR & Recruitment: Implemented recruitment management, CV parsing, applicant screening, and ATS-like workflows.
Frontend Architecture & Integrations: Developed reusable components, responsive interfaces, modular features, and backend API/AI service integrations to automate workflows and support scalability.

projects.title: StreetSuite
projects.subtitle: Stock market alerts platform
projects.description: Developed a web-based stock market platform designed to help users follow trading strategies, receive stock market alerts, and make informed trading decisions. Implemented responsive user interfaces, subscription plan management, and API integrations to deliver a seamless user experience.
highlights: Stock Alerts & Strategies: Built interfaces enabling users to follow trading strategies and receive stock-related alerts.
Subscription Management: Developed UI workflows for subscription plans and platform features.
Frontend Development: Created reusable components, responsive layouts, and maintainable frontend architecture.
API Integration: Integrated backend APIs to support platform functionality and dynamic data rendering.

projects.title: Right Decision
projects.description: Marketing website for a Saudi establishment specialized in customer experience that focuses on development and achieving results, providing high expertise specifically designed throughout the project lifecycle.

projects.title: Liard for Travelling
projects.description: Landing page for a travelling company.

experiences.title: Senior Frontend Developer
experiences.description: Frontend engineer on a large-scale, multi-tenant e-commerce marketplace platform (similar to Shopify) serving multiple tenants across diverse business domains. Built highly customizable tenant experiences through dynamic configuration, theming, and reusable components, supporting 100+ tenants.
highlights: Implemented tenant-specific workflows, feature flags, permissions, and access control for secure and flexible user experiences.
Contributed to a monorepo consolidating 3 company projects, defining shared UI libraries and reusable business logic that reduced duplicated code by 97%.
Raised code quality through unit testing, code reviews, and clean architecture, reaching 98% test coverage and improving page load time by 90%.

experiences.title: Senior Frontend Developer
experiences.description: Developed tourism applications that handle 100,000+ live records using Server-Sent Events for real-time updates.
highlights: Led a social media integration project connecting Meta (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp) and LinkedIn to manage pages, posts, ads, and campaigns, serving 1k+ users.
Implemented role-based email management, interactive WhatsApp templates with media and buttons, and API-driven customer and email campaign workflows.
Optimized Dart (SaaS) by refactoring the frontend architecture and using Next.js middleware to merge redundant backend ping requests into one call, cutting requests by 95%.
Wrote unit tests with Jest and React Testing Library and maintained technical documentation for integrations and workflows.

experiences.title: Senior Frontend Developer
experiences.description: Led a team of 8 frontend developers, setting standards for architecture, code reviews, and delivery.
highlights: MachineGenius (AI SaaS): Built modules for AI content generation, automated video production, and HR recruitment (CV parsing and ATS-style screening). Helped content writers produce 5–6+ scripts daily.
StreetSuite (Stock Alerts Platform): Built interfaces for following trading strategies, receiving alerts, and managing subscription plans, used by 100+ subscribers.

experiences.title: Frontend Developer
experiences.description: Designed and built responsive web applications with React.js, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and RESTful APIs. Improved performance and responsiveness across 5 projects.

experiences.title: Front End Developer
experiences.description: As a Frontend Developer, I designed and developed responsive, user-friendly web interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery, ensuring cross-browser compatibility and optimal performance. I utilized MVC architecture to structure applications effectively and implemented AJAX for dynamic content updates and seamless data interaction. My role involved collaborating with backend teams to integrate APIs and deliver smooth user experiences while maintaining clean, reusable code.
